shots.focal_element: Giant two-line stat '10X / FASTER' centred over a teal-to-lime gradient with concentric chevron line pattern
shots.transition_other: Stat text swaps in on the same gradient backdrop; 'FASTER' resolves from a blur (incoming edge from s017 not visible in this packet)
shots.typography: Heavy geometric sans, all caps, very tight tracking on the oversized '10X', smaller but still bold 'FASTER' beneath; pure white; font guess (low confidence): a grotesk like Inter Display/Graphik Bold
shots.what_happens: Lands on the VO stat 'up to 10 times faster' (w133-w137): 'FASTER' de-blurs into focus while a field of nested chevron/diamond outlines expands outward behind the text like a speed tunnel; on the last frame a circular dark mask opens in the centre revealing the analyst-badge row, starting the wipe into s019/s020.
shots.build_rebuild: Render '10X' and 'FASTER' as centred white bold text over an animated radial gradient, blur-in 'FASTER' (filter blur 12px to 0 over ~0.4s ease-out) while concentric stroked chevron SVG paths scale up from the centre in a staggered loop, then expand a circular clip-path from the centre to reveal the next scene.

shots.focal_element: Small dark-navy circular mask in the centre of the gradient containing a cropped 'FORRESTER' wordmark
shots.typography: Serif wordmark (Forrester logo), all caps, cropped by the circle edge
shots.what_happens: Two-frame fragment (51.03-51.10 s) in the middle of the circular mask wipe from the stat card to the proof/logo scene; code flagged it as a hard cut but visually it is the circle iris, so it reads as part of the s018 to s020 wipe. VO starts 'That's' (w138).
shots.build_rebuild: Treat as part of the s018 to s020 transition: animate a circle clip-path on the next scene's dark layer from a small radius to full-frame over ~0.3s with an ease-in-out curve.

shots.focal_element: 4x4 grid of white customer logos (EY, adidas, HomeServe, Gannett, Citi, Emerson, IBM, Wyndham, Airbnb, Kroger, L'Oreal, Samsonite, PayPal, McAfee, StepStone, Costco) above a row of four analyst/review badges
shots.transition_other: Completion of the circular mask wipe begun in s018/s019 (detector split the wipe)
shots.typography: Badge labels in small all-caps sans with wide tracking ('LEADER 2025', 'TOP LEADER'), five-star rows under TrustRadius and G2; customer logos rendered as monochrome white wordmarks
shots.what_happens: On 'That's why top enterprises trust Conductor to win an AI search' (w138-w148) the badge row first sits alone mid-frame, the G2 stars fill to five, then the row slides down while the customer logo wall fades in above with a staggered depth-of-field effect (individual logos blur in and out of focus); at the end a white 'Target topic' card starts entering from the top-left.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a centred row of four badge components, animate it translateY down ~150px while a 4x4 grid of white SVG logos fades in with random stagger (opacity 0 to 1, filter blur 8px to 0 then some logos re-blur), on a dark navy radial-gradient background with a soft vignette.

shots.focal_element: Simplified content-editor UI with a 'Content Score' progress bar that climbs from 0% to 92%
shots.transition_other: White UI card grows out from the top-left corner over the logo wall and settles centred
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans, sentence case, medium weight for labels and bold for 'Guidance'; percentage in tabular-looking numerals; body copy shown as grey skeleton bars rather than text
shots.what_happens: Over 'Conductor's enterprise-grade platform is purpose-built for one goal' (w149-w159) the target topic types in ('Ham an' to 'Ham and cheese sandwich'), skeleton lines fill the editor body, and the Content Score bar counts up 0% -> 26% -> 43% -> 69% -> 91% -> 92% while its colour shifts from orange to amber to green; on the final frame the whole card tilts in 3D perspective to hand off to s022.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a white editor card (top bar with topic input and score bar, left 'Guidance' column, right editor with skeleton text rows); typewrite the topic, stagger-add grey bars to the editor, and tween the score width and counter 0 to 92 in steps with background colour interpolated orange to green, then rotateY the card ~20deg as an exit.

shots.focal_element: Stylised blog page card titled 'Best Wireless Headphones 2025' with a hero photo of a person wearing headphones
shots.transition_other: 3D card swing: the editor tilts away and a blog card swings in from the left with motion blur, background switching back to the teal-lime gradient
shots.typography: Geometric sans, title in bold sentence case, small regular-weight 'Blog' nav label
shots.what_happens: On 'generating website content that gets found across every' (w160-w167) the blog card swings in with skeleton text lines flying in from the right, straightens to face camera, then a green trophy marked with AI-engine icons pops up over the page with a burst of green/teal confetti shapes while a second card begins sliding in from the left edge.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a blog-page card from rotateY(-35deg) with motion blur to flat, slide skeleton text rows in from the right with a stagger, then scale-pop a trophy illustration (scale 0 to 1 with slight overshoot) and emit confetti SVG shapes outward from behind it.

shots.composition_other: Layered cards: chart card overlapping bottom-left of the blog card, trophy and confetti upper right
shots.focal_element: 'AI Visibility Over Time' stacked area chart card (Apr-Sep) overlapping the blog page and trophy
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans chart title in sentence case, small grey month labels; same family as the editor and blog cards
shots.what_happens: Over 'AI's search surface from perplexity to Google' (w168-w174) the chart card slides in from the left and its stacked area chart builds up layer by layer (two greens, then orange and red bands appear) with an upward trend, while a small dot marker drifts along the top series; the trophy with AI-engine icons and confetti stays behind it.
shots.build_rebuild: Slide a white chart card in from x=-100% with ease-out, then grow a stacked area chart (D3/SVG) one series at a time by animating each path's y-scale from the baseline, and move a small circle marker along the top series.
